control-missing-display-name.summary: PCF control manifests need a display-name-key so the control has an accessible name.

control-missing-description.summary: PCF control manifests need a description-key documenting the control's purpose.

property-missing-display-name.summary: Bound/input/output properties need a display-name-key so they have an accessible name.

property-missing-description.summary: Properties need a description-key documenting their purpose.

standard-control-manual-keyboard-review.summary: Standard (non-virtual) controls own their own DOM/canvas rendering and need manual keyboard-operability review.

dataverse-tab-label-empty.summary: Dataverse form tabs need a non-empty label.

dataverse-section-label-empty.summary: Dataverse form sections need a non-empty label.

dataverse-cell-label-empty.summary: Dataverse form fields need a non-empty label.

dataverse-section-label-hidden.summary: A section with showlabel="false" hides its grouping label from every user, not only visually.

dataverse-cell-label-hidden.summary: A field cell with showlabel="false" hides its label from every user, not only visually.
